g.title: G
g.text: Autonomic Nervous System & Pharmacology — Concept Map (NURS 419, Lecture 10/1/2026)
Preganglionic = ACh → Nn · β₁ = 1 heart, β₂ = 2 lungs · ↓ BP → reflex tachycardia, ↑ BP → reflex bradycardia · PARALYSIS ≠ SEDATION ≠ ANALGESIA

g.title: wiring
g.text: sweat glands: sympathetic but ACh → muscarinic
adrenal medulla: epi + NE into blood

g.title: recep
g.text: β₁ heart: rate, strength, conduction, renin
β₂ lungs: bronchodilation, K⁺ into cells, ↑ glucose

g.title: reflex
g.text: BP = CO × SVR · CO = HR × SV

g.title: safety
g.text: don't stop clonidine or β-blockers abruptly
